title: Colorful music app landing hero with organic blob shapes and phone mockup
whatItIs: A web hero section with a blue border frame, colorful overlapping blob shapes on the left surrounding a music-app phone mockup, and a bold 'More Music. More Fun.' headline with CTA on the right.
whatItMeans: Overlapping organic blobs in varied bright colors behind a phone mockup create energy and playfulness appropriate for a consumer entertainment product, without needing a busy photo.
techniques: overlap several organic blob shapes in varied colors to create a playful, energetic backdrop
frame the entire hero section in a bold solid-color border for a distinct 'card' feel
